sourceText: Close the audit-discovered defect where dev_finish and dev_merge advance a story's phase outside runStoryTransition, and serialize same-owner concurrent transitions.
normalizedOutcome: No registered command can advance a story's phase without routing through runStoryTransition (review round minted, phase_transition event appended, correct REVIEW label); concurrent same-owner transitions produce exactly one review round.
acceptanceClaim: The transition-integrity smoke shows dev_finish routes through the orchestrator (4 assertions pass) and two concurrent same-owner DEV->REVIEW transitions yield one review round.
